visual_action: In an office setting with an American flag, Vice President Kamala Harris and Second Gentleman Doug Emhoff are seated on a couch. An unidentified man with his back to the camera tells someone on a phone call that he has a surprise for them, revealing Harris and Emhoff. He then places the phone on speaker on a small table in front of them. Harris and Emhoff lean in and have a warm conversation with the person on the phone.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: She is visually identified on screen and speaks for most of the video, thanking a volunteer.

cast.name: Douglas Emhoff
cast.evidence: He is visually identified sitting next to Kamala Harris throughout the video.

cast.name: Kathy
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris addresses her by name ("Hi Kathy!") and she is the person on the other end of the phone call being thanked.

cast.name: unnamed man
cast.evidence: A man, mostly off-screen or with his back to the camera, introduces the surprise call at the beginning of the video.

on_screen_text.text: Well, I have a very special surprise for you.
I'm here with Madam Vice President Kamala Harris
and Second Gentleman Doug Emhoff,
and they wanted to say a few words.
Oh my gosh.
Hi Kathy!
Oh my gosh!
I just can't thank you enough,
because truly, we couldn't do any of this
if it weren't for that kind of firepower
that you bring to it, you know?
I mean, we're a team.
Well, I feel honored to be on that team
and really so inspired.
How are you doing? I hope –
I know that you are working as much, if not more than,
a full-time staffer.
I hope you are taking care of yourself also.
I am, you know, the way everyone does.
We could not do what we are doing
if it weren't for the work you're putting into it.
I mean, truly.
On the ground, you know,
we can't talk directly to everyone.
And so, you doing that really does carry
the voice that also is about empowering people
and empowering communities,
and that's really important.
It's really an honor.
It's a privilege to do this work.
And I couldn't envision myself
doing anything else right now.
Just sincerely, we appreciate you so much
and we're very thankful to you
and just filled with gratitude
that you're out there doing this.
So thank you.
Well, thank you so very much.
What an honor. What an honor.

spoken_summary: An aide surprises a volunteer named Kathy with a phone call from Vice President Kamala Harris and Second Gentleman Doug Emhoff. Kathy is audibly surprised and delighted. Vice President Harris expresses deep gratitude for Kathy's hard work, calling it "firepower" and emphasizing that their efforts depend on volunteers like her. She says, "we're a team." Kathy says she feels honored and inspired. The call is filled with mutual appreciation, with Harris acknowledging the volunteer's extensive work and encouraging her to take care of herself.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of conversational dialogue between the people in the room and the person on the phone. There is no background music or other sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is edited with minimal cuts, mostly featuring a static shot of Kamala Harris and Doug Emhoff on a couch. The pacing is slow and conversational, presented as a single, authentic interaction.
central_claim: The Democratic party and its leaders, like Vice President Harris, deeply appreciate and rely on the hard work of their grassroots volunteers.
intended_effect: To make volunteers and supporters feel seen, valued, and inspired, and to portray the party leadership as personally connected to their base.
